blocks.text: Yeh Unit 13 (Differentiation) ke poore unit se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, unit ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal mukhtasar qadmon mein hal kiya gaya hai.
13.1 Tangent to a Curve at a Point

blocks.prompt:
1 Define a secant line of a curve and write the slope of the secant through the points with x-coordinates \(x\) and \(x + \delta x\) on \(y = f(x)\).
(Curve ki secant line ki definition likhein aur \(y = f(x)\) par \(x\) aur \(x + \delta x\) wale points se guzarne wali secant ka slope likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Secant woh line hai jo curve ko do points par kaat'ti hai. \(P(x, f(x))\) aur \(Q(x + \delta x, f(x + \delta x))\) se: \(m_{\text{sec}} = \dfrac{f(x+\delta x) - f(x)}{\delta x}\).

book_ref.quote: A secant cuts a curve at two points

blocks.prompt:
2 Write the slope of the tangent to \(y = f(x)\) at \(P(x, f(x))\) as a limit, and say how it is related to the secant.
(\(y = f(x)\) ki \(P(x, f(x))\) par tangent ka slope limit ki shakal mein likhein aur batayein is ka secant se kya talluq hai.)
blocks.explanation: \(m_{\text{tan}} = \lim_{\delta x \to 0}\dfrac{f(x+\delta x) - f(x)}{\delta x}\). Jab \(\delta x \to 0\), \(Q\) point \(P\) ke qareeb aata hai aur secant \(PQ\) tangent \(PT\) ban jati hai; yaani \(m_{\text{tan}}\) \(m_{\text{sec}}\) ki limit hai.

book_ref.quote: the secant line becomes the tangent line

blocks.prompt:
3 Find the slope of the secant to \(f(x) = x^{2} - 4x\) through the points where \(x = 1\) and \(x = 4\).
(\(f(x) = x^{2} - 4x\) ki secant ka slope nikalein jo \(x = 1\) aur \(x = 4\) wale points se guzarti hai.)

book_ref.quote: every derivative is a limit

blocks.prompt:
4 Using the limit for \(m_{\text{tan}}\), find the gradient of the tangent to \(f(x) = x^{2} + 4\) at the point \((2, 8)\).
(\(m_{\text{tan}}\) ki limit se \(f(x) = x^{2} + 4\) ki point \((2, 8)\) par tangent ka gradient nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Limit mein \(x = 2\) rakhein aur \(\delta x\) cancel karein.

book_ref.quote: Working pattern: substitute, expand, cancel the common factor

blocks.prompt:
5 The tangent to \(f(x) = x^{2} + 4\) at \((2, 8)\) has slope \(4\). Find its equation.
(\(f(x) = x^{2} + 4\) ki \((2, 8)\) par tangent ka slope \(4\) hai. Us ki equation nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Point-slope form: \(y - 8 = 4(x - 2) \Rightarrow y = 4x\).

book_ref.quote: Then use the point-slope form

blocks.text: 13.2 Derivative as the Limit of a Difference Quotient

blocks.prompt:
6 Define the derivative of a function \(f\) with respect to \(x\).
(Function \(f\) ke \(x\) ke lehaaz se derivative ki definition likhein.)
blocks.explanation: \(f'(x) = \lim_{\delta x \to 0}\dfrac{f(x+\delta x) - f(x)}{\delta x}\), basharte ke limit mojood ho, \(f\) ka \(x\) ke lehaaz se derivative (differential coefficient) hai; parhte hain \"f prime of x\".

book_ref.quote: provided the limit exists, is defined to be the derivative of

blocks.prompt:
7 Find the average rate of change of \(f(x) = x^{2} - 3x\) as \(x\) changes from \(1\) to \(5\).
(Jab \(x\) \(1\) se \(5\) tak badle to \(f(x) = x^{2} - 3x\) ki average rate of change nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: represents the average rate of change in the value of

blocks.prompt:
8 When is a function \(f\) said to be differentiable at \(x\)? What is the domain of \(f'\)?
(Function \(f\) ko \(x\) par differentiable kab kehte hain? \(f'\) ka domain kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Agar \(x \in D_{f}\) ho aur \(f'(x)\) mojood ho to \(f\) \(x\) par differentiable hai. \(f'\) ka domain woh tamam \(x\) hain jin ke liye limit mojood ho.

book_ref.quote: is said to be differentiable at

blocks.text: 13.2.1 Derivative as the rate of change of velocity

blocks.prompt:
9 A particle moves so that \(s(t) = t^{2} + 5t\) metres after \(t\) seconds. Find its average velocity over \([1, 3]\).
(Aik particle ki position \(t\) second baad \(s(t) = t^{2} + 5t\) metres hai. \([1, 3]\) par average velocity nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: The average velocity over the interval from

blocks.prompt:
10 For \(s(t) = t^{2} + 5t\) metres, find the instantaneous velocity at \(t = 1\) by the limit.
(\(s(t) = t^{2} + 5t\) metres ke liye limit se \(t = 1\) par instantaneous velocity nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: \(v_{\text{inst}} = \lim_{\delta t \to 0}\dfrac{s(1+\delta t) - s(1)}{\delta t}\) istemal karein.

book_ref.quote: the instantaneous velocity is the derivative of the position function

blocks.prompt:
11 Differentiate between average velocity and instantaneous velocity.
(Average velocity aur instantaneous velocity mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Average velocity aik interval par hoti hai; instantaneous velocity aik lamhe par (limit).

book_ref.quote: the average velocity becomes the instantaneous velocity

rows: Position graph ki secant ka slope.
Tangent ka slope; s(t) ka derivative.

blocks.prompt:
12 Write the notations for the derivative of \(y = f(x)\) used by Leibniz, Newton, Lagrange and Euler.
(\(y = f(x)\) ke derivative ke liye Leibniz, Newton, Lagrange aur Euler ke notations likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Chaaron ka matlab aik hi derivative hai.

book_ref.quote: Notations for the derivative of y = f(x) used by different mathematicians

blocks.prompt:
13 Is \(\dfrac{dy}{dx}\) a quotient of \(dy\) and \(dx\)? Explain.
(Kya \(\dfrac{dy}{dx}\), \(dy\) aur \(dx\) ki taqseem hai? Wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation: Nahi. \(\dfrac{dy}{dx}\) aik hi symbol hai jo \(\lim_{\delta x \to 0}\dfrac{\delta y}{\delta x}\) (yaani \(y\) ka \(x\) ke lehaaz se derivative) ko zahir karta hai; isay \(y'\) bhi likhte hain.

book_ref.quote: and here it is not a quotient of

blocks.prompt:
14 Using \(f'(a) = \lim_{x \to a}\dfrac{f(x) - f(a)}{x - a}\), find \(f'(2)\) for \(f(x) = x^{3}\).
(\(f'(a) = \lim_{x \to a}\dfrac{f(x) - f(a)}{x - a}\) se \(f(x) = x^{3}\) ke liye \(f'(2)\) nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: is called the derivative or gradient of

blocks.prompt:
15 If \(y = x^{2} + 1\), find \(\delta y\) when \(x\) changes from \(3\) to \(3.1\).
(Agar \(y = x^{2} + 1\) ho to \(x\) ke \(3\) se \(3.1\) hone par \(\delta y\) nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: subtract \(y = f(x)\) from both sides of (iv) to get the change in \(y\) alone

blocks.text: 13.3.2 Finding f'(x) by Definition of Derivative

blocks.prompt:
16 Write the four steps for finding \(f'(x)\) by definition.
(Definition se \(f'(x)\) nikalne ke chaar qadam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Step I: \(f(x + \delta x)\) nikalein. Step II: \(f(x + \delta x) - f(x)\) simplify karein. Step III: \(\delta x\) se taqseem karke simplify karein. Step IV: \(\lim_{\delta x \to 0}\dfrac{f(x+\delta x) - f(x)}{\delta x}\) nikalein.

book_ref.quote: can be found by the following four steps

blocks.prompt:
17 Find by definition the derivative of \(f(x) = 4x - 7\).
(Definition se \(f(x) = 4x - 7\) ka derivative nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: \(f(x + \delta x) - f(x) = 4\delta x\); \(\delta x\) se taqseem: \(4\); limit: \(f'(x) = 4\).

book_ref.quote: The method of finding derivatives by this process is called differentiation by definition

blocks.prompt:
18 Find by definition the derivative of \(f(x) = x^{2} - 5x\).
(Definition se \(f(x) = x^{2} - 5x\) ka derivative nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Chaar qadam; \(x^{2}\) aur \(-5x\) cancel ho jate hain.

book_ref.quote: Expand \((x+\delta x)^{n}\), cancel, take out \(\delta x\)

blocks.prompt:
19 Find by definition the derivative of \(f(x) = \dfrac{3}{x}\), \(x \ne 0\).
(Definition se \(f(x) = \dfrac{3}{x}\), \(x \ne 0\) ka derivative nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Common denominator lein, phir \(\delta x\) cancel karein.

book_ref.quote: Common denominator, then factorize

blocks.prompt:
20 Find by definition the derivative of \(f(x) = 2\sqrt{x}\), \(x > 0\).
(Definition se \(f(x) = 2\sqrt{x}\), \(x > 0\) ka derivative nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Numerator ko rationalize karein.

book_ref.quote: Whenever a square root appears in the numerator of the difference quotient, rationalize the numerator

blocks.prompt:
21 Find \(\dfrac{dy}{dx}\) at \(x = 1\) by ab-initio method if \(y = \dfrac{1}{x + 1}\).
(Agar \(y = \dfrac{1}{x + 1}\) ho to ab-initio tareeqe se \(x = 1\) par \(\dfrac{dy}{dx}\) nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Common denominator se \(\delta y\), taqseem, limit, phir \(x = 1\).

book_ref.quote: With fractions, the key algebra move is taking a common denominator.

blocks.prompt:
22 Why must \(\delta x\) be cancelled before letting \(\delta x \to 0\) in Step III?
(Step III mein \(\delta x \to 0\) karne se pehle \(\delta x\) cancel karna kyun zaroori hai?)
blocks.explanation: Simplify karne se pehle \(\delta x = 0\) rakhne par \(\frac{0}{0}\) aata hai jis ki koi qeemat nahi. \(\delta x \ne 0\) hai (sirf \(0\) ki taraf ja raha hai), is liye pehle cancel karte hain, phir limit.

book_ref.quote: Using a shortcut rule when the question says

blocks.text: 13.4 Derivation of x^n where n in Z

blocks.prompt:
23 State the power rule. For which values of n does the unit prove it?
(Power rule bayan karein. Unit mein yeh n ki kin qeematon ke liye sabit kiya gaya hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(\dfrac{d}{dx}(x^{n}) = nx^{n-1}\). Yeh \(n \in \mathbb{Z}\) ke liye sabit hai: positive integers (binomial theorem se) aur negative integers (\(n = -m\) rakh kar). Rational powers ke liye bhi durust hai; \(n \in \mathbb{Q} - \mathbb{Z}\) ka saboot exercise par chhoda gaya hai.

book_ref.quote: is called power rule. Where

blocks.prompt:
24 Differentiate \(\dfrac{1}{\sqrt[3]{x}}\) with respect to \(x\).
(\(\dfrac{1}{\sqrt[3]{x}}\) ko \(x\) ke lehaaz se differentiate karein.)

book_ref.quote: Before using the power rule, write roots and reciprocals as powers

blocks.prompt:
25 Differentiate \(x^{-\frac{5}{2}}\) with respect to \(x\).
(\(x^{-\frac{5}{2}}\) ko \(x\) ke lehaaz se differentiate karein.)

book_ref.quote: Reducing the power by one in the wrong direction for negative powers

blocks.prompt:
26 Find the gradient of \(y = x^{\frac{3}{2}}\) at \(x = 9\).
(\(y = x^{\frac{3}{2}}\) ka \(x = 9\) par gradient nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: \(\dfrac{dy}{dx} = \dfrac{3}{2}\sqrt{x}\); \(x = 9\) par \(\dfrac{9}{2}\).

book_ref.quote: The above rule also holds if

blocks.prompt:
27 Using the binomial theorem, find \(\delta y\) for \(y = x^{4}\) and hence \(\dfrac{dy}{dx}\).
(Binomial theorem se \(y = x^{4}\) ke liye \(\delta y\) aur phir \(\dfrac{dy}{dx}\) nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: \(\delta y = 4x^{3}\delta x + 6x^{2}(\delta x)^{2} + 4x(\delta x)^{3} + (\delta x)^{4}\); \(\delta x\) se taqseem aur limit se \(\dfrac{dy}{dx} = 4x^{3}\).

book_ref.quote: Using the binomial theorem, we have

blocks.prompt:
28 Can the power rule be used to differentiate \(2^{x}\)? Give a reason.
(Kya power rule se \(2^{x}\) differentiate ho sakta hai? Wajah batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Nahi. Power rule sirf \(x^{n}\) (constant power \(n\)) ke liye hai. \(2^{x}\) mein variable power mein hai.

book_ref.quote: Using the power rule for \(a^{x}\) (variable in the power)

blocks.prompt:
29 State the relation between continuity and differentiability of a function at a point.
(Kisi point par function ki continuity aur differentiability ka talluq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Agar function kisi point par differentiable ho to wahan continuous bhi hoga. Ulat zaroori nahi: \(f(x) = |x|\) \(x = 0\) par continuous hai magar differentiable nahi.

book_ref.quote: differentiability implies continuity, but the reverse is not necessarily true
However the derivative exists at all other points of

blocks.prompt:
31 Is \(f(x) = |x + 3|\) differentiable at \(x = -3\)? Give a reason.
(Kya \(f(x) = |x + 3|\) \(x = -3\) par differentiable hai? Wajah batayein.)
blocks.explanation: \(\dfrac{f(-3 + \delta x) - f(-3)}{\delta x} = \dfrac{|\delta x|}{\delta x}\): daayen limit \(1\), baayen \(-1\). Barabar nahi, is liye \(f'(-3)\) mojood nahi.

book_ref.quote: The right hand and left hand limits are not equal

blocks.prompt:
32 Why is there no tangent line to the graph of \(f(x) = |x|\) at the origin?
(\(f(x) = |x|\) ke graph ki origin par tangent line kyun nahi?)
blocks.explanation: \(O\) par graph ka nokeela kona hai: baayen slope \(-1\), daayen \(1\). Tangent ko aik muqarrar slope chahiye, magar \(f'(0)\) mojood nahi.

book_ref.quote: there is no tangent line to the graph of

blocks.prompt:
33 Differentiate \(6x^{\frac{5}{3}}\) with respect to \(x\).
(\(6x^{\frac{5}{3}}\) ko \(x\) ke lehaaz se differentiate karein.)
blocks.explanation: Formula 3 aur power rule: \(6 \cdot \frac{5}{3}x^{\frac{2}{3}} = 10x^{\frac{2}{3}}\).

book_ref.quote: the derivative of a constant function is zero

blocks.prompt:
34 Find \(\dfrac{dy}{dx}\) if \(y = \dfrac{1}{2}x^{4} - 3x^{2} + 7x - 1\).
(Agar \(y = \dfrac{1}{2}x^{4} - 3x^{2} + 7x - 1\) ho to \(\dfrac{dy}{dx}\) nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Har term alag: \(\dfrac{dy}{dx} = 2x^{3} - 6x + 7\).

book_ref.quote: The sum or difference formula can be extended to find the derivative of more than two functions.

blocks.prompt:
35 Differentiate \((x^{2} + 3)(x - 2)\) by the product rule.
(\((x^{2} + 3)(x - 2)\) ko product rule se differentiate karein.)

book_ref.quote: first's derivative times second, plus first times second's derivative

blocks.prompt:
36 Differentiate \(\dfrac{x + 1}{x - 1}\), \(x \ne 1\), with respect to \(x\).
(\(\dfrac{x + 1}{x - 1}\), \(x \ne 1\) ko \(x\) ke lehaaz se differentiate karein.)

book_ref.quote: (bottom times derivative of top) minus (top times derivative of bottom), all over bottom squared

blocks.prompt:
37 Differentiate \((\sqrt{x} + 1)^{2}\) with respect to \(x\).
(\((\sqrt{x} + 1)^{2}\) ko \(x\) ke lehaaz se differentiate karein.)
blocks.explanation: Pehle khol lein: \(x + 2x^{\frac{1}{2}} + 1\). Derivative: \(1 + \dfrac{1}{\sqrt{x}}\).

book_ref.quote: Write roots as powers before differentiating

blocks.prompt:
38 Differentiate \(\dfrac{x^{2}}{x^{2} + 4}\) with respect to \(x\).
(\(\dfrac{x^{2}}{x^{2} + 4}\) ko \(x\) ke lehaaz se differentiate karein.)

book_ref.quote: Losing the minus sign in front of the second product in the quotient rule

blocks.prompt:
39 Find \(\dfrac{dy}{dx}\) if \(y = (2x - 1)(3x + 4)\).
(Agar \(y = (2x - 1)(3x + 4)\) ho to \(\dfrac{dy}{dx}\) nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: If \(f\) and \(g\) are differentiable at \(x\), then \(fg\) is also differentiable

blocks.prompt:
40 State the product rule and the quotient rule of differentiation.
(Differentiation ka product rule aur quotient rule bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Product rule: \([f(x)g(x)]' = f'(x)g(x) + f(x)g'(x)\). Quotient rule (\(g(x) \ne 0\)): \(\left(\dfrac{f(x)}{g(x)}\right)' = \dfrac{f'(x)g(x) - f(x)g'(x)}{[g(x)]^{2}}\).

book_ref.quote: Now we will prove other important formulas (or rules)

blocks.prompt:
41 Find \(\dfrac{dy}{dx}\) if \(y = \dfrac{x^{3} - 1}{x - 1}\), \(x \ne 1\).
(Agar \(y = \dfrac{x^{3} - 1}{x - 1}\), \(x \ne 1\) ho to \(\dfrac{dy}{dx}\) nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Pehle simplify: \(y = x^{2} + x + 1\) (\(x \ne 1\)). Is liye \(\dfrac{dy}{dx} = 2x + 1\).

book_ref.quote: Simplifying first (Examples 8, 9) or using the product rule (Example 10) gives the same answer

blocks.prompt:
42 Find \(\dfrac{dy}{dx}\) if \(y = x^{3} + \dfrac{1}{x^{3}}\).
(Agar \(y = x^{3} + \dfrac{1}{x^{3}}\) ho to \(\dfrac{dy}{dx}\) nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: Power rule slips with fractions

blocks.prompt:
43 Differentiate \(\dfrac{1}{3x + 2}\) with respect to \(x\) by the quotient rule.
(\(\dfrac{1}{3x + 2}\) ko quotient rule se differentiate karein.)

book_ref.quote: Forgetting that the derivative of a constant term is 0

blocks.prompt:
44 A firm's profit is \(P(x) = 200x - 4x^{2}\). Find the marginal profit when \(x = 15\) units.
(Aik company ka profit \(P(x) = 200x - 4x^{2}\) hai. \(x = 15\) units par marginal profit nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: \(P'(x) = 200 - 8x\); \(P'(15) = 80\): aik aur unit se profit taqreeban \(80\) barhta hai.

book_ref.quote: the marginal profit is the derivative of the profit function with respect to

blocks.prompt:
45 A particle moves with \(s(t) = 2t^{3} + t^{2}\) metres. Find its velocity and acceleration at \(t = 1\) s.
(Aik particle \(s(t) = 2t^{3} + t^{2}\) metres ke mutabiq chalta hai. \(t = 1\) s par velocity aur acceleration nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: velocity is the derivative of the position function, and acceleration is the derivative of the velocity function

blocks.prompt:
46 An investment is worth \(V(t) = 3000(1 + 0.02t)^{2}\) rupees after \(t\) years. Find its rate of change after \(5\) years.
(Aik investment ki qeemat \(t\) saal baad \(V(t) = 3000(1 + 0.02t)^{2}\) rupay hai. \(5\) saal baad rate of change nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: the rate of change of the investment is the derivative of

blocks.prompt:
47 The stress in a beam is \(S(x) = 200x - x^{3}\) Pa at \(x\) metres from the fixed end. Find the rate of change of stress at \(x = 4\) m. Is the stress increasing or decreasing there?
(Aik beam mein stress \(S(x) = 200x - x^{3}\) Pa hai. \(x = 4\) m par stress ki rate of change nikalein. Kya stress wahan barh raha hai ya ghat raha hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(S'(x) = 200 - 3x^{2}\); \(S'(4) = 152\) Pa fi metre. Musbat hai, is liye \(x = 4\) m par stress barh raha hai.

book_ref.quote: the rate of change of stress is the derivative of

blocks.prompt:
48 The cost of a tank is \(C(r) = 3000\pi r^{2} + \dfrac{24000}{r}\), \(r > 0\). Find the radius at which \(C'(r) = 0\).
(Aik tank ki cost \(C(r) = 3000\pi r^{2} + \dfrac{24000}{r}\), \(r > 0\) hai. Woh radius nikalein jahan \(C'(r) = 0\) ho.)
blocks.explanation: \(C'(r) = 6000\pi r - \dfrac{24000}{r^{2}} = 0 \Rightarrow r^{3} = \dfrac{4}{\pi}\), cube root: \(r \approx 1.084\).

book_ref.quote: A smallest (or largest) value occurs where the derivative is zero

blocks.prompt:
49 A particle moves with \(s(t) = t^{3} - 9t^{2} + 24t\) metres. When is it at rest?
(Aik particle \(s(t) = t^{3} - 9t^{2} + 24t\) metres ke mutabiq chalta hai. Woh kab rukta (at rest) hai?)

book_ref.quote: Position \(s(t)\) \(\to\) \(s'(t)\) is velocity
